_provenance.note: WS-8 (2026-08-30): CKM_AES_GMAC did not exist in this engine at all before this session. PKCS#11 v3.2 Sec6.13.6: GMAC is C_Sign/C_Verify where pData IS the AAD (no plaintext/ciphertext). Implemented via OpenSSL EVP_MAC "GMAC" (OSSL_MAC_NAME_GMAC) -- verified this data==AAD reading directly against a real ACVP vector via the openssl(1) mac CLI before writing any C++, matching the methodology used throughout this session's WS-8/5.2 work. Required extending MacAlgorithm with a new setIV() virtual (GMAC is the only MAC mechanism here that takes one) -- setTruncatedMacSize, already present for *_HMAC_GENERAL, covers ulTagBits truncation without further changes. This sample dataset only covers 128-bit keys (no 192/256 groups exist in it). 1 sign case (with AAD) + 1 verify-pass + 1 verify-fail case (testPassed=false, confirming rejection is real, not just that matches pass).
